detail.longDescription: UseIt is an AI design studio for things you can hold. Describe what you want in one sentence. UseIt asks what a designer would ask, designs it with you, and lets you refine any detail by pointing at it. You get a real, editable design file, not a flat image, ready to print, cut and fold, with real dimensions, bleed and dielines. Make pins, stickers, gift boxes, pop-up cards, brand kits and more. Use it in your browser, or call it up anywhere on your Windows desktop.
